name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport began unexpectedly after a career in telecommunications. While initially focused on the financial sector, a chance encounter at a local rally event sparked an interest in the intricate data analysis and systems that underpin modern racing. He transitioned into motorsport IT, quickly establishing himself as a highly competent professional.

Bjørn's approach to IT systems management is characterized by meticulous planning and a relentless pursuit of stability. He believes that a robust and reliable IT infrastructure is critical for optimizing performance on the track. His detail-oriented approach ensures that even the smallest issues are addressed promptly, minimizing downtime and maximizing the team's competitive edge.

What sets Bjørn apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with a pragmatic mindset. He understands the pressures of the racing environment and is adept at finding practical solutions to complex technical challenges. His dedication to perfection, coupled with his ability to work quickly and efficiently, makes him an invaluable asset to RSC Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Bjørn has a sturdy build and a focused gaze that suggests a mind constantly at work.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even in the office.
Insists on using a wired mouse, claiming wireless is 'unreliable'.
Tidies his desk obsessively before leaving for the day.
